description: Heavy-Duty Electric Fleet Depot Charging Load Profiles & Substation Load Integration Assessment Results is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This data set includes the 24-hour fleet depot charging load profiles (15-min. average demand) and substation load integration assessment results produced for the study, "Heavy-Duty Truck Electrification and the Impacts of Depot Charging on Electricity Distribution Systems", published in 2021 ( The code developed to generate these load profiles is publicly available at Please cite ... Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Transportation, Electricity. Its keywords are distribution system, electric vehicles. The portal shows 2025-01-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is National Laboratory of the Rockies License (https://data.nrel.gov/node/182/license). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
